summary: ObjectGenome.decodeMechanismPosition reads mechanism.kind through normal table indexing before enforcing the canonical plain-data boundary. A metatable-backed record can therefore execute __index and synthesize a canonical-looking mechanism kind at the shared decoder boundary, even though the same record class is rejected by ObjectGenome.inspect().
evidence: src/shared/Objects/ObjectGenome.luau: mechanismPositionIsValid() branches on mechanism.kind without a type/metatable preflight; decodeMechanismPosition() then branches on mechanism.kind again.

Docs/OBJECT_GENOME.md defines mechanism records as canonical plain data and decodeMechanismPosition() as the shared decoder boundary used to prevent adapters from inventing competing persisted-state semantics.
Current main ObjectGenome contract tests prove inspect()/inspectState() reject metatable-backed canonical tables, but do not cover the exported decoder path.

Branch agent/tests/HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME-k8v2q6m4 adds a no-execute regression: a hostile __index that returns kind='caster' must be rejected before any field read. Current production behavior is expected to fail this new assertion.
